profile.summary: The Administration for Children and Families is a division of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services. It runs federal programs for children, youth and families, and provides national leadership to help families lead economically and socially productive lives. Its Office on Trafficking in Persons funds the Human Trafficking Youth Prevention Education demonstration program for school districts.
